model_conventions.checked_scope: The convention is limited to the exact `PG24LiteralBasicMarket` field paths below and is parented only by `stable_matching_cutoff_definitionSpec_proof`, whose direct input is that record. It supplies source-model provenance for those fields, not any attenuation or amplification conclusion.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: The source basic economy and cutoff characterization are represented by one explicit `PG24LiteralBasicMarket` record: its student law and value coordinate, strict preferences and cutoff demand, iid outcome law, capacity vector and total-capacity equality, score representation, and capacity regularity are the primitive data used by the cutoff-based stable-matching definition.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source specifies these economy ingredients across the basic-model and cutoff-characterization passages, whereas the Lean stable-matching Spec receives them as fields of a structured record. Enumerating every field path prevents any record member from acquiring source credit merely by sharing a model-shaped name.
